# Current pi/8 profile inputs

Copyright 2026 Qleisli Project Contributors. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.

These two explicit current translations remove only the retired
`use std::quantum::phase;` directive. The bare language primitive, exact integer
arguments, complete type/owner bodies, notices and physical line endings stay
unchanged. Both original manifests already declare edition2026 and are copied
byte-for-byte. `translation-index.json` binds the unchanged embedded historical
files to these separate current sources and the exact removed byte ranges.

The immutable first-observations.json and phase() history audit stay unchanged.
The live helper reads these checked current files; it never executes recorded
commands, rewrites source at runtime, or falls back to old imports. Its same four
fresh one-qubit commands retain hierarchy producer-consistency/request scope,
exact `(1,4)`/axis101 proposal fields, Raw refusal and exponent9 limit refusal.
No new coefficient domain, acceptance authority, numerical tolerance, source
preservation theorem or after-run success is claimed by adding translations.
